items.Sentence: Wedge wire static screen that removes solids from the influent to the aerobic digester before they reach the Sequencing Batch Reactors (SBR) tanks.
Two SBR tanks in parallel, one is filled while the other performs its various treatment process steps.
Settled (waste) activated sludge is wasted to an aerobic digester where it further degrades aerobically to a solids concentration of 1.5-3.5%.
The waste activated sludge is pumped, with the addition of polymer, into a wedge wire type sludge drying bed for further dewatering to an approximate solids concentration of 10 - 30%.
Storage pond; storage capacity is approximately 7.8 million gallons (MG); managed as a treated effluent disposal/storage pond, as the pond is not lined.
Emergency storage pond has storage capacity of approximately 3.23 MG (approximately ten-day storage capacity).
The effluent pump is located at the plant. The effluent pump has the ability to pump through either of these 2 pipes, depending upon valving.
The ultimate destination of biosolids produced is Monterey Regional Waste Management District landfill located at 14201 Del Monte Blvd in Marina.
